systems.system: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)
systems.owner: Direção Geral dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação (DGRNI), Ministério da Justiça e Trabalho
systems.tiers: Central system, created by Lei n.º 43/VIII/2013, for identification, civil authentication and the citizen's life cycle; supplies data for the CNI, the electronic passport and the residence title; national and diaspora coverage is a stated aim, not a stated fact

systems.system: Bases de dados registais e de identificação civil
systems.country_label: bases de dados registais e de identificação civil
systems.tiers: Data shared with other public entities; what the databases hold and where they are entered is not described

note: Ministry of Justice page (undated; 2020 inferred) describing DGRNI and SNIAC. It says DGRNI registers facts of civil status and runs SNIAC as an identification and authentication system, but not that any conservatória enters a birth or death digitally, nor which events, how or in how many offices. SNIAC is an identity system by this description, so no fact.
